title: OpenAI 为青少年推出了更安全的 ChatGPT——在青少年开始使用几年后
content: ChatGPT for Teens 增加了适合年龄的安全措施、家长控制和学习工具，旨在引导青少年远离有害内容，并避免使用人工智能在作业上作弊。
original_title: OpenAI launches a safer ChatGPT for teens — years after teens started using it
original_content: ChatGPT for Teens adds age-appropriate safety measures, parental controls, and learning tools designed to steer teens away from harmful content — and from using AI to cheat on their homework.

title: 人们正在“嫁给”聊天机器人。这些立法者想要阻止他们
content: 美国法律目前不承认人类与人工智能的婚姻。一些共和党州的政策制定者正在起草立法以保持这种状态。
original_title: People Are ‘Marrying’ Chatbots. These Lawmakers Want to Stop Them
original_content: Human-AI marriages are not currently recognized by US law. Some Republican state policymakers are drafting legislation to keep it that way.
